private_specimen_store.facts: The predecessor tail is 1799-1939; the real successor ordinal_continuation_base is 1939 and its first rebased native MID is ccm-1940.

sanitized_public_source.fact: Carry block bytes, roles, serving MIDs, and source ordinals are copied from the sanitized specimen without semantic reconstruction.

producer_meta_passthrough.fact: The current output path clones msg.ck, retaining ingress meta.

descent_rebase_stamp.fact: rebase_descent_ordinals maps the first fresh native ordinal through base+1 and line 2592 stamps meta.ordinal.

harness_meta.fact: HarnessMeta defines harness_id, ordinal, synthetic, summary, errored, finish, created_at_ms, and completed_at_ms.

synthetic_mid_literals.fact: M0_ID is mc_m0, the frozen-prefix block identity literal for m1 is mc_m1#0, and R44b fixes synthetic todo serving MIDs as <call_id>:call and <call_id>:result.

source_evidence.implementation_status: The claude-code-anthropic profile-epoch stamping implementation is intentionally absent from this fixture task; v1.3.25 and R44b settle the gateway and non-identity metadata behavior pinned here.

returned_view_grammar.coordinate_source: Every output coordinate is read only from returned CkMessage meta.harness_id and meta.ordinal stamps.
returned_view_grammar.native_message_ce1_assignment: F / mc.d5.F.v1 over normalized messages; NativeMessage and its normalized position, ordinal, index, and endpoint inputs are unchanged.
returned_view_grammar.source_segment_ce1_assignment: manifest_digest / mc.d5.manifest.v1 over ManifestV1; SourceSegment and the manifest predecessor identities are unchanged.
returned_view_grammar.preimage_change: none; ReturnedMessageViewV1 is not an input to either clause-2a assignment.
returned_view_grammar.evaluation_scope: The gateway evaluates ReturnedMessageViewV1 only on the clause-21a carry-proof path while carry is outstanding.
returned_view_grammar.proof_mismatch_transport: Any returned-view stamp or locator defect is proof_mismatch with HTTP 503 and gateway error.code d5_carry_proof_mismatch.
returned_view_grammar.outside_scope: Without outstanding carry the returned-message view is not evaluated and produces no gateway verdict.
returned_view_grammar.synthetic_serving_mids: m0=mc_m0; m1=mc_m1; synthetic todo=<call_id>:call and <call_id>:result. These values are meta.harness_id stamps.
returned_view_grammar.synthesized_messages: Only m0, m1, and the synthetic todo pair are returned synthesized messages.
returned_view_grammar.gateway_view_limit: The gateway returned-message view reads harness_id, ordinal, and synthetic and nothing else.
returned_view_grammar.provider_rendering: Provider rendering omits all HarnessMeta metadata.

observed_geometry.content_rule: Synthetic prefix content is deterministic equal-length stand-in data. Carry content is the existing sanitized specimen data. The 1940 suffix payload is a stand-in because only its real serving MID, rebased ordinal, and continuation base are contract evidence here.
